summary: 28-year-old Missouri hiker Christopher Michael Fontaine in distress near Snowmass Lake; search began Tuesday afternoon after reports of a hiker in distress and a call from his employer after he missed work; rescuers reached him ~9 p.m. Tuesday and called for an immediate helicopter airlift due to his condition; flown to Aspen Valley Hospital.
location: near Snowmass Lake, Maroon Bells-Snowmass Wilderness
notes: AP reprint via St. Joseph Post; mechanism/condition not reported.
